scope: National Dex representative per species; form and regional variants not counted independently
statusRule: Explicit historical Shadow dex only; Pokémon GO main-game normal species outside this list are NOT automatically treated as released Shadow Pokémon.
shinyRule: Shiny Shadow and Shiny Purified released only when base Shiny species is released and the species has had a Shadow release. This uses the current Rocket shiny eligibility change; regional, event and acquisition-specific exceptions require separate audit.

notes.shadow: Includes historically obtainable Shadow species and their evolutions, not only current Rocket encounter pool. Unobtainable leader-only Shadow Kangaskhan (115) excluded.
notes.purified: A purified species is eligible if its Shadow species is obtainable; purified is not inferred from an unrelated ordinary spawn.
notes.lucky: Only normally released species and tradeable species counted; Mythicals except Meltan/Melmetal, Zygarde and Eternatus excluded.
notes.art: Uses exact GO normal/shiny species transparent sprite with a clearly labeled status effect because GO PNG asset manifest has no standalone Shadow/Purified/Lucky icon variant.
